title: Weds runtime sprint handoff - prep notes (Elena)
content:
Meeting: Weekly Runtime Sprint Handoff (Weds) - 45m
Owner (prep): Elena Rivera
When: Wed 09:30 PT (timebox 45m)
Attendees likely: Arjun, Diego, Tyra, Marcus (on call), + SRE buddy if available

Goals for this sync:
- Quick status on high-risk work that could affect canary or customer latency (5m)
- Handoff open infra items to next sprint + owners (10m)
- Console/alerts triage: recurring flapping alerts and proposed fixes (10m)
- KV cache warm-start experiment update + rollout plan (10m)
- Action-item review + blockers (10m)

Prep notes (what I need to say / ask):
- Infra ticket INFRA-4021 (node eviction tuning) — brief the group on recent test results: p95 tail improved but saw 2x cpu spike during GC; need decision: roll forward to staging canary or revert change. Ask: Arjun — do we have a rollback window on Dedicated?
- Batching regression we saw in SR-178: lower throughput at long sequences after quantization tweak. Diego to summarize perf delta and hypothesis (is it kernel scheduling or scheduler mis-config?).
- Console alert: "api-serving-latency-flap" keeps reopening every night 03:xx UTC. Suspect autoscaler churn + cache cold-starts. Propose temporary alert suppression window 02:30-04:00 while we run warm-starts. ASK: Tyra — can SRE set muted window for next two nights?
- KV cache warm-start script (toy script in PR 987) — status: basic warmup works on small models, fails for long-seq due to memory fragmentation. Action: validate on a 2-node staging pool. Need volunteer to run and capture memory profiles.

Agenda with micro-prompts (for meeting flow):
- 0:00-0:05 quick round: any blockers that must be mentioned? (call out demos or customer incidents)
- 0:05-0:15 INFRA-4021 decision (Elena -> short demo of perf graphs, Arjun -> recommendation)
- 0:15-0:25 SR-178 batching regression (Diego -> root cause hypothesis + short plan)
- 0:25-0:35 Console alerts + muting proposal (Tyra -> SRE impact + temporary plan)
- 0:35-0:40 KV cache warm-start rollout (Elena -> ask for test owners and acceptance criteria)
- 0:40-0:45 Action items + quick sync on who owns what next week

Unresolved questions to raise in meeting:
- If we mute the alert window, do we lose useful signals for low-level regressions? (long term: need alert enrichment with "customer-impacting" label)
- Can the Dedicated clusters accept a staged kernel change without breaking existing reservations? (Ops constraint)
- Who will champion memory-fragmentation debug on the warm-start? We might need pprof trace on the staging node.

Action items (live tracking lines - keep as checklist in meeting):
- [ ] Decision: deploy INFRA-4021 to canary staging (owner: Arjun Patel, due: 2026-03-13)
- [ ] Run KV warm-start on 2-node staging pool + capture memory profiles (owner: Diego Martinez, due: 2026-03-14)
- [ ] Create short runbook for nightly alert mute (owner: Tyra Singh, due: 2026-03-13)
- [ ] Open follow-up ticket to investigate batching scheduler interactions with quantized kernels (owner: Diego Martinez, linked: SR-178, due: 2026-03-16)
- [ ] Add "customer-impact" tag to console alerts and prototype enrichment (owner: Elena Rivera, due: 2026-03-20)
- [ ] Notify Dedicated customers of potential maintenance window if kernel change goes to prod (owner: Arjun Patel, due: 2026-03-18)

Notes to self (stream-of-consciousness prep):
- Keep INFRA-4021 summary to 2 slides (perf chart + risk table). Don't dig into GC internals unless asked.
- If Diego says kernel scheduler, ask whether a kernel fallback (older kernel) is cheap vs re-tuning scheduler.
- Remember to call out the rollback window constraints for Dedicated. We need explicit OK from product for any customer-visible change.
- Take meeting minutes snapshot and paste into INFRA-4021 comment thread and Confluence canary playbook.

Follow-ups after meeting (what I will do immediately):
- Post minutes + checklist in #runtime-sync, tag owners (5–10m after meeting)
- Create PR link for warm-start run artifacts and add Diego's profile outputs
- Draft short customer note template (if we escalate to maintenance) and run by Arjun

Misc (notes / thoughts):
- Could we run KV warm-start at low priority on Dedicated to avoid customer impact? Need ops input.
- Longer-term: add a nightly cache-warm job in Console that runs per-cluster with rate-limiting; prototype after warm-start stabilizes.

Slack references to paste during call:
- #runtime-sync thread: https://slack.redwood.ai/runtime-sync (copy after meeting)
- PR to show: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/987
- Ticket to link in minutes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4021

End of notes. Will keep this doc as the canonical prep + action-item tracker for the next two handoffs.

-- Elena
